hypothesis: Jerome's step 1 after the call of 29 Oct 2026 (transcript 37:41, 28:18, 29:29): reproduce thesis Fig. 6.3 for other kernel families K_theta than the C = 8 Gaussian mixture, and ask whether the advantage of EM-BP over score networks on the Laplace chain belongs to the mixture or to the structure (a first-order shift kernel inside exact BP). Two kinds of family. (i) SHIFT families K(a'|a) = phi_theta(a' - alpha a), the class the Laplace chain lives in, with log phi expanded in four bases at the mixture's parameter count (25): cubic B-splines and Gaussian radial basis functions (local bases) and a Fourier series and Legendre polynomials (global bases, Jerome's 'truncated Fourier series' and 'polynomial'). (ii) AGNOSTIC families that know only that the chain is first-order Markov with one kernel at every link: E43's log-linear 2-D spline kernel (100 parameters) and E55's neural energy kernel K = exp(-E_theta(a, a'))/Z with E_theta a two-hidden-layer MLP (Jerome's 'neural kernel', step 2, here on the chain he calls the paper's largest section). The working expectation: any reasonable shift family keeps EM-BP's advantage over every network, local bases fit the Laplace kink better than global ones, and generality has a price (E43, E30's MDN) that puts the agnostic families between the shift families and the best network.
design: DATA. E03's bundles, imported as E30 imports them (e03._cell_common, e03._one_view_groups, e03._sq, e03._risk; tags exp31-*): the Laplace AR(1) chain alpha = 0.85, L = 32, grid 401 on [-8, 8], the twelve frozen levels, N in (32, 128, 512, 2048) training chains, one noisy view per chain split over the twelve levels (E03's corruption interface, so every arm learns from the same corrupted sample), validation 1024 and test 2048 chains per seed. ARMS, all learned by EM through exact grid BP (markov_score.em.fit_em) and selected at the checkpoint with the lowest pooled BP risk on the validation bundle (E30's rule; the networks of E03 were selected the same way). (1-4) Shift families: log K(a'|a) = -lambda eps^2 / 2 + sum_{k=1}^{23} c_k b_k(clip(eps, -W, W)) - log Z(a), eps = a' - alpha a, W = 4 (7.6 innovation standard deviations), Z(a) the grid's trapezoid sum (column normalisation, as energy_kernel), theta = (alpha, log lambda, c_1..c_23): 25 parameters, the mixture's count. Bases: spline = 23 cubic B-splines with clamped, equally spaced knots on [-W, W]; rbf = exp(-(eps - mu_k)^2 / 2 ell^2) with 23 centres mu_k equally spaced on [-W, W] and ell their spacing; fourier = cos(k pi eps / W), k = 1..12, and sin(k pi eps / W), k = 1..11; legendre = P_k(eps / W), k = 1..23. The quadratic envelope carries the tails beyond W, where every basis is held constant by the clip. Start: alpha = 0.3, lambda = 1 / 0.8, c = 0, i.e. exactly E30's em_bp start (Gaussian AR(1), rho 0.3, var 0.8). M-step: generalised EM, n_inner = 10 Adam steps on Q(theta) / (number of transitions), lr 1e-2, the step redone at half the rate up to 6 times if Q did not increase (energy_kernel's rule, amendment N-24), so Q never decreases. (5) loglinear2d: markov_score.loglinear_kernel.LogLinearKernel, 10 x 10 cubic B-splines (100 parameters), exact concave M-step, started at the same Gaussian AR(1). (6) energy: markov_score.energy_kernel.NeuralEnergyKernel, uniform start, lr 1e-2, n_inner 10, hidden width chosen from (16, 32, 64) by the screen part on the dev seeds (pooled validation risk over N in (32, 2048)), float64. LADDER for all six arms: E55's EM_LADDER (10 ... 2400), so a generalised M-step is not cut short where E30's exact mixture M-step stopped at 1200. COMPARATORS, frozen and joined on (seed, N, test_bundle hash): E30's em_bp (the C = 8 mixture refitted on these bundles, 25 parameters) and mdn (1,516), E03's six networks (window CNN, global MLP, BiGRU, TCN, transformer, U-Net, each its screened winner), E02a's em_bp for continuity. Reference: exact grid BP with the true Laplace kernel (risk 0 by construction). KERNEL ERROR (for P5 and Fig. 6.3): the stationary-weighted Hellinger distance sum_j pi(a_j) w_j H(K_hat(.|a_j), K(.|a_j)), pi the true chain's invariant law on the grid. PARTS: verify (gate G1), timing (dev seed 10000, N = 2048: seconds per EM iteration per arm), screen (energy width), fit (confirmatory), densities (learned log phi on eps in [-3, 3] at 161 points for the shift arms, the conditional K(.|a) at a in (-1, 0, 1) for every arm, N in (128, 512, 2048)). ROWS per (seed, N, arm, t): sq_err, sq_ref, risk_level, risk_pooled, checkpoint, at_cap, n_params, val_risk, val_curve (checkpoint:risk), evidence at every checkpoint, q_halvings, monotone_violation, wall per iteration, theta, kernel_hellinger, failed, stop_reason.

predeclared_predictions.P1: Structure, not the mixture. Each of the four shift families (spline, rbf, fourier, legendre) has a lower seed-mean pooled test risk than the best of E03's six networks (the lowest seed-mean at that N) at every N in (32, 128, 512, 2048), and is lower in at least 13 of 16 paired seeds at each N. FALSIFIED by any shift family at any N.
predeclared_predictions.P2: The basis matters little inside the right class. At N in (128, 512, 2048) each shift family's seed-mean risk is within a factor 1.5 of E30's em_bp (the C = 8 mixture on the same bundles), in either direction. N = 32 is reported, not predicted.
predeclared_predictions.P3: Generality has a price (E43 on the field, E30's MDN here). At every N both agnostic arms (loglinear2d, energy) have a higher seed-mean risk than E30's em_bp, in at least 13 of 16 paired seeds.
predeclared_predictions.P4: The agnostic kernels still beat the networks without structure. At N in (128, 512, 2048) both agnostic arms have a lower seed-mean risk than E03's global MLP and than its window CNN, each in at least 12 of 16 paired seeds. Against BiGRU, the best network, no direction is predicted (E30's MDN tied it: 0.066 against 0.060 at N = 2048); see D4.
predeclared_predictions.P5: The kink. At N = 2048 each local-basis family (spline, rbf) has a lower kernel error than each global-basis family (fourier, legendre): four local-global pairs, each in at least 12 of 16 paired seeds.

descriptive.D1: Step efficiency (Jerome, 23:50): EM iterations at the selected checkpoint and to reach within 5% of the arm's final validation risk, per arm and N, beside the training steps of E03's networks at their selected checkpoints (E03 val_curve); the validation-risk curve against updates for EM-BP and the best network on one axis.
descriptive.D2: Thesis Fig. 6.3 per family: the learned log phi against the Laplace truth at N = 128, 512, 2048 (shift arms), and K(.|a) at a = -1, 0, 1 for every arm.
descriptive.D3: Seconds per EM iteration and iterations used, per arm (cost beside accuracy).
descriptive.D4: Agnostic arms against BiGRU, and the energy kernel against E30's MDN, per N: paired counts and seed means, no prediction.

(1) AT_CAP: the driver writes at_cap = (selected checkpoint == the last SAVED one), and fit_em also saves the final iterate of a run that converged early, so that column also flags converged fits whose last iterate won the selection. outcome.P1: CONFIRMED. Every shift family is below the best network at every N, in 16 of 16 paired seeds everywhere (best network: window CNN at N = 32, BiGRU above). Seed means at N = 32/128/512/2048: spline 0.0886/0.0588/0.0419/0.0276, rbf 0.0925/0.0598/0.0413/0.0273, fourier 0.1037/0.0712/0.0480/0.0289, legendre 0.0899/0.0608/0.0433/0.0284; best network 0.1861/0.1211/0.0782/0.0596.
outcome.P2: CONFIRMED. Shift family / em_bp seed-mean ratios at N = 128, 512, 2048 lie in 1.07-1.34 (spline 1.07-1.19, rbf 1.09-1.18, legendre 1.10-1.23, fourier 1.25-1.34), inside the factor 1.5. The mixture (em_bp 0.0551/0.0359/0.0231) stays slightly the best of the 25-parameter shift kernels.
outcome.P3: FALSIFIED, by the energy kernel only. The log-linear 2-D kernel is above em_bp in 16 of 16 seeds at every N (0.2383/0.1687/0.1451/0.1317), as predicted. The neural energy kernel (width 16, E56's screen) is not reliably worse: em_bp is lower in 8, 12, 12 and 8 of 16 seeds at N = 32, 128, 512, 2048, and at N = 2048 the seed means are 0.0235 (energy) against 0.0231 (em_bp). Generality cost the agnostic neural kernel nothing measurable at N = 2048.
outcome.P4: FALSIFIED, by the log-linear 2-D kernel only. Both agnostic kernels beat the global MLP in 16 of 16 seeds at N = 128, 512, 2048, and the energy kernel beats the window CNN in 16 of 16 there, but the log-linear 2-D kernel loses to the window CNN in 16 of 16 (0.1687/0.1451/0.1317 against 0.1413/0.1209/0.1181).
outcome.P5: FALSIFIED. At N = 2048 the kernel errors (stationary-weighted Hellinger) of the four shift families are within 0.046-0.049 (spline 0.0480, rbf 0.0458, fourier 0.0494, legendre 0.0461); local-below-global holds in 10, 4, 10 and 8 of 16 seeds (spline<fourier, spline<legendre, rbf<fourier, rbf<legendre), each short of 12. At this sample size the basis does not separate on the kink. The energy kernel has the lowest kernel error of all arms (0.0394; 0.1071 for the log-linear 2-D).
